items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee describes a scenario where Andy Kirk's band was present at the venue ('all Andy Kirk's band was sitting'), but the interviewee does not claim to have played with, met, or collaborated with Andy Kirk personally, only observing the band.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, yeah. Tell you what happened. Andy Kirk's band played the Howard Theatre in Washington and always when you play the Howard Theatre you play the Royal Theater the next week. Well the Royal Theatre was in Baltimore. The trip time from Washington to Baltimore is just an hour. So anyway when a band would close at the Howard Theatre that night, the next band come in the next day. Well the band that closed would always wait and see what this other band was going to play, because the first show at the Royal…
myself together, I said doggone, let me drink some coffee here and get myself together. So anyway, I did and got up on stage and all Andy Kirk's band was sitting, you know--are we still going?
